Kimi K2 Thinking (open-source) stormed the internet not too long ago for beating a lot of benchmarks and competing with closed-source models. To be honest, I don't think benchmarks cover a lot of the story nowadays so I remained skeptical. Today, I tried it for the first time on Homework 12

The model thinks (particularly?) fast and seems to do very good with a comparable performance to other models like OpenAI's (which I am more familiar with). Shortcomings include the poor vision component. The commentary goes more deeply into how I guided it to do the homework. Ultimately, it did very well and only demanded prompting to describe visual figures and ask for a particular style of responses.

Not a Fireship video but good enough.
